defaultAlias: default aliases the first canonical case; not an extra case
unknown: Unknown case/subfixture/configuration or unsupported dispatch phase throws
phaseDescriptors: PAM_API_PHASES maps phase keys to {type,api,hook,flags,label,dispatch?,internal?,useCachedChain?,debugArgument?,cleanupFlags?}. api is the C identifier without parentheses. Nonmodule rows always have moduleHook/rawReturn/action/accumulators null, even when their descriptor names an API.
configuration: {service,revision,files:[{id,service?,file,sha256,text}],includeTree,comparison?,settings?,assumption?}; SSH UsePAM/method settings describe configured profile, not completed invocations
step: pamEvaluation={configurationId,configurationHash,service,file,line,text?,type,apiPhase,api,flags,moduleHook,hookCalled,rawReturn,controlStatus?,mappedAction,accumulatorBefore,accumulatorAfter,depth,nextRow,skipStopReason,executed,inapplicable?,aggregateReturn?,resourceConfiguration?}; API rawReturn is never fabricated from aggregateReturn
resourceConfiguration: {configurationId,configurationHash,file,rows:[{line,text}],applicationResult}; show resource lines separately from the required PAM control
canonicalPathsScope: PAM01 workstation fields. Existing Linux keeps its workstation namespace; SSH keeps pam.lastEvaluation/pam.results as declared by model.pamStatePaths. Aggregate state is a library result, not a fabricated caller admission decision.
history: Source-owned config, opaque transaction handle, caller API arguments, callback inputs, local aggregate returns and receipt, module/action/accumulator records, caller decision, authority generations, process/session lifecycle and cleanup. Prepare/source rows are explicitly nonmodule, never copies of later hook completion.
bookkeeping: moduleCredentials and partialSessionResources track selected credential/setup lifecycle bookkeeping, not invented native credentials or handles.
heldAdapter: Existing explicit Unix adapter consumes unixWorkstation/workstationInventory unchanged; parent owns top-level dispatch registration.
nativeHelper: tools/verification/compare-pam-native.py; independent docs/pam-foundations/native-expectations.json; never /etc or real account modules
integrationUI: Parent owns active-phase config panel, canonical case/default alias, named subfixture picker, comparison diff and related variant links. Selected subfixture profile is not an added URL grammar.
unsupportedActions: arbitrary pasted configuration outside authored fixed registry
callerReturns: API aggregateReturn/pamAggregate are separate from rawReturn and become caller-owned only on local return receipt. Render output fields only at completed canonical source prefix. Prepare rows stay explicitly nonmodule.

statePathDeclaration.semantics: No mirrored namespaces. Missing results mean a not-reached/not-completed API, never a null aggregate. API-only return rows have aggregateReturn and null module fields.

existingOperationReplay: Combined sudo setup and named cleanup triggers carry pending API metadata, followed by real-library-owner module records and completed API-return records delivered to the calling controller. Partial rootok has no return; sufficient root success is completed without requiring a later continuation.
